'''Tatiana Marins Roque''' (born April 24, 1970) is a Brazilian [[History of mathematics|historian of mathematics]] and politician.

== Academic career ==
[[File:Tatiana_Roque_ICM_2018_4.jpg|left|thumb|200px|Tatiana Roque at the International Congress of Mathematicians in 2018]]

Roque is a professor at the [[Institute of Mathematics, UFRJ|Institute of Mathematics]] (IM) of the [[Federal University of Rio de Janeiro]] (UFRJ),<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|date=June 19, 2018|title=Com comitês de gênero, matemáticas brasileiras ganham força e estreiam em congresso centenário|url=https://www.generonumero.media/com-comites-de-genero-matematicas-brasileiras-ganham-forca-e-estreiam-em-congresso-centenario/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180914022156/http://www.generonumero.media/com-comites-de-genero-matematicas-brasileiras-ganham-forca-e-estreiam-em-congresso-centenario/|archive-date=September 14, 2018|access-date=September 10, 2022|website=Gênero e Número|language=pt}}</ref> with a Ph.D. in [[Manufacturing engineering|Production Engineering]] from the [[COPPE|Alberto Luiz Coimbra Institute of Graduate Studies and Research in Engineering]] (Coppe), also at UFRJ.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|last=França|first=Victor|date=February 3, 2023|title=Professora da UFRJ assumirá Ciência e Tecnologia do Rio|url=https://conexao.ufrj.br/2023/02/professora-da-ufrj-assumira-ciencia-e-tecnologia-do-rio/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230204200243/https://conexao.ufrj.br/2023/02/professora-da-ufrj-assumira-ciencia-e-tecnologia-do-rio/|archive-date=February 4, 2023|access-date=February 4, 2023|website=Conexão UFRJ|language=pt}}</ref> Her research area covers the historiography of mathematics, the relationship between history and mathematics education, and the history of [[differential equation]]s and celestial mechanics theories at the turn of the 19th to the 20th century. Her book ''História da matemática: uma visão crítica, desfazendo mitos e lendas'' (2012) was one of the winners of the 2013 [[Prêmio Jabuti|Jabuti Award]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Premiados do Ano {{!}} 64º Prêmio Jabuti|url=https://www.premiojabuti.com.br/premiados-por-edicao/premiacao/?ano=2013&categoria=2c0c25c0-6a21-e811-a837-000d3ac085f9|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200811005547/https://www.premiojabuti.com.br/premiados-por-edicao/premiacao/?ano=2013&categoria=2c0c25c0-6a21-e811-a837-000d3ac085f9|archive-date=August 11, 2020|access-date=September 10, 2022|website=Prêmio Jabuti}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=October 17, 2013|title=Anunciados os vencedores do Prêmio Jabuti 2013; confira a lista|url=https://gauchazh.clicrbs.com.br/geral/noticia/2013/10/anunciados-os-vencedores-do-premio-jabuti-2013-confira-a-lista-4304148.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220910014342/https://gauchazh.clicrbs.com.br/geral/noticia/2013/10/anunciados-os-vencedores-do-premio-jabuti-2013-confira-a-lista-4304148.html|archive-date=September 10, 2022|access-date=September 10, 2022|website=GZH|language=pt}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=October 18, 2013|title=Livro da prof.ª Tatiana Roque conquista Prêmio Jabuti 2013|url=http://www.im.ufrj.br/biblioteca/?p=8161|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190411220325/http://www.im.ufrj.br/biblioteca/?p=8161|archive-date=April 11, 2019|website=Biblioteca IM}}</ref>

She was a [[Public speaking|guest speaker]] at the 2018 [[International Congress of Mathematicians]], which took place in Rio de Janeiro, and served as the coordinator of {{interlanguage link|Forum of Science and Culture of the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro|lt=UFRJ's Forum of Science and Culture|pt|Fórum de Ciência e Cultura da Universidade Federal do Rio de Janeiro}} between 2019 and 2022.<ref>{{Cite web|date=July 31, 2019|title=Tatiana Roque, nova coordenadora do FCC, convida para o ciclo de palestras "Desastres e mudanças climáticas"|url=https://forum.ufrj.br/index.php/reetrospectiva/2019/937-tatiana-roque-nova-coordenadora-do-fcc-convida-para-a-aula-inaugural-do-ciclo-desastres-e-mudancas-climaticas|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220910014526/https://forum.ufrj.br/index.php/reetrospectiva/2019/937-tatiana-roque-nova-coordenadora-do-fcc-convida-para-a-aula-inaugural-do-ciclo-desastres-e-mudancas-climaticas|archive-date=September 10, 2022|access-date=September 10, 2022|website=Fórum de Ciência e Cultura da UFRJ}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Neto|first=Nelson Lima|date=July 6, 2022|title=Coordenadora do Fórum de Ciência e Cultura da UFRJ sai do cargo para ser candidata|url=https://blogs.oglobo.globo.com/ancelmo/post/coordenadora-do-forum-de-ciencia-e-cultura-da-ufrj-sai-do-cargo-para-ser-candidata.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220716025254/https://blogs.oglobo.globo.com/ancelmo/post/coordenadora-do-forum-de-ciencia-e-cultura-da-ufrj-sai-do-cargo-para-ser-candidata.html|archive-date=July 16, 2022|access-date=September 10, 2022|website=O Globo|language=pt}}</ref>

== Political career ==
In the 2018 elections, Roque ran as a candidate for Federal Deputy for the [[Socialism and Liberty Party]] (PSOL) in Rio de Janeiro. She received 15,789 votes but was not elected.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Tatiana Roque 5010 (PSOL) Deputada Federal {{!}} Rio de Janeiro|url=https://especiais.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2018/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220407154202/https://especiais.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2018/candidatos/rj/deputado-federal/tatiana-roque-5010/|archive-date=April 7, 2022|access-date=|website=Eleições 2018|date=October 28, 2018 |language=pt}}</ref> In the 2022 elections, she ran for the same position under the [[Brazilian Socialist Party]] (PSB).<ref>{{Cite web|last=Tussini|first=Gabriel|date=August 24, 2022|title="Nunca foi tão evidente a relação entre ciência e política", diz Tatiana Roque|url=https://oeco.org.br/salada-verde/nunca-foi-tao-evidente-a-relacao-entre-ciencia-e-politica-diz-tatiana-roque/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220827220329/https://oeco.org.br/salada-verde/nunca-foi-tao-evidente-a-relacao-entre-ciencia-e-politica-diz-tatiana-roque/|archive-date=August 27, 2022|access-date=September 10, 2022|website=((o))eco|language=pt}}</ref> She received 30,764 votes but was not elected, becoming the first alternate to {{interlanguage link|Eduardo Bandeira de Mello|pt|Eduardo Bandeira de Mello}}.<ref>{{Cite web|title=TATIANA ROQUE|url=https://eleicoes.poder360.com.br/candidato/1394237#2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220910002257/https://eleicoes.poder360.com.br/candidato/1394237|archive-date=September 10, 2022|access-date=September 10, 2022|website=Poder360}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Deputados federais eleitos no Rio de Janeiro: apuração e resultados das Eleições 2022|url=https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/poder/eleicoes/2022/apuracao/1turno/rj/deputado-federal.shtml|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221003211143/https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/poder/eleicoes/2022/apuracao/1turno/rj/deputado-federal.shtml|archive-date=October 3, 2022|access-date=October 8, 2022|website=Folha de S.Paulo|language=pt}}</ref>

In February 2023, she assumed the position of Secretary of Science and Technology of the city of Rio de Janeiro, being appointed by Mayor [[Eduardo Paes]].<ref name=":1"/><ref>{{Cite web|last=Sartori|first=Caio|date=January 27, 2023|title=Depois do PT, Paes acolhe o PSB com secretaria de Ciência e Tecnologia|url=https://valor.globo.com/politica/noticia/2023/01/27/depois-do-pt-paes-acolhe-o-psb-com-secretaria-de-cincia-e-tecnologia.ghtml|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230128071818/https://valor.globo.com/politica/noticia/2023/01/27/depois-do-pt-paes-acolhe-o-psb-com-secretaria-de-cincia-e-tecnologia.ghtml|archive-date=January 28, 2023|access-date=February 4, 2023|website=Valor Econômico|language=pt}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Coelho|first=Henrique|date=February 3, 2023|title=Prefeito do Rio de Janeiro dá posse a 14 novos secretários|url=https://g1.globo.com/rj/rio-de-janeiro/noticia/2023/02/03/prefeito-do-rio-de-janeiro-da-posse-a-novos-secretarios.ghtml|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230203161710/https://g1.globo.com/rj/rio-de-janeiro/noticia/2023/02/03/prefeito-do-rio-de-janeiro-da-posse-a-novos-secretarios.ghtml|archive-date=February 3, 2023|access-date=February 4, 2023|website=G1|language=pt}}</ref>
